name: Anglické popisky (SHOT, SFX, ON SCREEN) + české repliky + způsob v závorce ZA uvozovkou + víceslovná role + trojtečky uvnitř repliky
text:
SHORT: "Parkování"
CHARACTERS: Martin (male, 30s), Petra (female, 30s), Parking attendant (male, 60)
PROPS: parking ticket

SHOT 1 – EXT. PARKING LOT – DAY
Martin backs the car into a tight spot. Petra watches the mirror.
PETRA: "Ještě kousek… ještě… stop!" (panicky)

SHOT 2
MARTIN: "V pohodě, mám to pod kontrolou." (confident)
SFX: crunch of plastic

SHOT 3
The attendant knocks on the window.
PARKING ATTENDANT: "Dobrý den, tady se parkuje jen s lístkem." (dry)
ON SCREEN: "Parkoviště P2"

SHOT 4
Martin hands over the parking ticket. Petra hides her face.
MARTIN: "Tady je." (quietly)
lines: V pohodě, mám to pod kontrolou.
Dobrý den, tady se parkuje jen s lístkem.
